author: Loic
text:
New builds for the Pixel 11 Pro XL (kodiak), Pixel 11 Pro (grizzly), Pixel 11 (cubs) and Pixel 11 Pro Fold (yogi), synced with this week's Evolution X source.

🔄 Already on the October 16 build? Settings > System > System updates has this one; it installs in the background, then restart. Rooted? Use Magisk > Install > Install to inactive slot (after OTA) instead of restarting, or root is gone.

What's new upstream:
• Google apps updated from Pixel 11 Pro firmware CD1A.261005.003
• Android System WebView 155.0.8059.39
• Evolver: spoofing settings redesigned in Material 3 Expressive
• Bluetooth no longer turns itself back on by default
• Mobile network: falls back to visible cells when a network scan is rejected
• Bug reports include the full kernel log
• Emergency information: picking a photo works without a crop app
• Translation updates across Evolution X and LineageOS apps

⚠️ Known issue: a user has reported that Now Playing won't turn on in this build. It's being looked into.

Unchanged: Espada kernel v3 (Linux 6.12.92) by Kevtrejo37 on kodiak, grizzly and cubs (yogi stays on stock Google GKI), Extreme Charging, the charging screensaver, "Use device MAC" for Wi-Fi networks that filter by MAC address (since the 10-16 build), and stock CD1A.261005.003 firmware (security patch 2026-10-05).

author: denson9874
text:
Update: 2026-10-21 build

New build of Evolution X 12.3 (Android 17) for the Pixel 8 Pro, synced with upstream Evolution X cnb and LineageOS on 2026-10-21.

What's new

Extreme Charging on husky: the Quick Settings tile now works on the Pixel 8 Pro. Below 50% on a wired charger it relaxes the charge-temperature throttling, so the phone keeps charging faster while you use it. It turns itself off when you unplug or reach 100%. The 47 °C and 55 °C charging cut-offs, USB-port protection and the battery's own temperature limits are unchanged; expect the phone to run warmer while it's on.
Pixel face unlock: face unlock now uses the Pixel 8 Pro's own face unlock (LineageOS device tree update). If you used face unlock before, set it up again in Settings > Security & privacy > Device unlock.
Faster first boot after updates: SystemUI and Settings now ship precompiled, so they're fully optimized from the first boot instead of recompiling.
User build, like the Pixel 11 releases.
Upstream Evolution X: SystemUI no longer polls lockscreen widgets in the background, and the Wi-Fi icon updates on events instead of polling; DynamicBar redesign; torch fixes for long-press power; App Lock, Settings and Evolver updates; latest LineageOS changes.

Known issues

Notification shade animations can still drop frames. I traced it to SystemUI's notification list layout and I'm working on it.
Gemini Nano features don't work (Google serves the models only to phones with a locked bootloader).

Downloads (SourceForge: husky/17)

ROM: EvolutionX-17.0-20261021-husky-12.3-Unofficial.zip
SHA-256: 3fcd713310bb9b1d1947fec588bef98931676f9edfc8e9fe6e746c85faa8f69b
Recovery images for clean installs: boot-20261021.img and vendor_boot-20261021.img (SHA-256 in recovery-20261021.sha256)

Updating from an earlier build keeps your data: reboot to recovery, Apply update > Apply from ADB, then

	
	



	
		Code:
	
	
		adb sideload EvolutionX-17.0-20261021-husky-12.3-Unofficial.zip
	
and reboot. For a clean install, follow the first post using the dated recovery images.

Tested on my Pixel 8 Pro (October CP3A firmware) as an update from the 10-16 build: verified boot green, SELinux enforcing, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, NFC, mobile data, both cameras, fingerprint, 43 sensors, 120/60 Hz.

author: denson9874
text:
DerpFest v17 — Android 17
Google Pixel 8 Pro (husky) | UNOFFICIAL​

	
	



	
		Code:
	
	
		/*
 * Your warranty is now void. You flash this at your own risk.
 * I'm not responsible for bricked devices, lost data, or anything else.
 */
	

About
An unofficial build of DerpFest v17 (Android 17, LineageOS 24.0-based) for the Google Pixel 8 Pro (husky).

husky has an official DerpFest maintainer, Adrian Szymański (Adi20_01 on Telegram), whose last official build is v16.2. This is not an official DerpFest build. It brings Android 17 to the Pixel 8 Pro until an official v17 build is out. Please don't report its bugs to the DerpFest team or to Adrian: report them in this thread or in the Telegram group.

For the Google Pixel 8 Pro (husky) only. Don't flash this on the Pixel 8 (shiba), Pixel 8a (akita), or any other model.

Build info

DerpFest v17, Android 17, security patch 2026-10-01 (system), 2026-08-05 (vendor)
Build type: user, signed with private release keys
Google apps included
Kernel: Linux 6.1.157 (GKI android14-6.1, built from LineageOS's gs-6.1 sources)
Firmware: stock CP3A.261005.005 (October 2026, ripcurrent bootloader and modem), included in the zip
Device trees: LineageOS 24.0 (the same revisions as LineageOS's official husky build of 2026-10-16)
Not rooted

Highlights

DerpFest's customizations: DerpFest Parts, themes, clocks, Game Space, freeform windows, and more
Gemini Nano runtime (AICore) included
Built-in call recorder: Basic Call Recorder (BCR) 3.11 by chenxiaolong (see the notes below)
Over-the-air updates through DerpFest's Updater (from this build's own update server, not DerpFest's official one)

Call recording (BCR)

Basic Call Recorder (BCR) 3.11 by chenxiaolong is built in as a system app (GPL-3.0, source: chenxiaolong/BCR v3.11).
BCR is off until you open it and turn on Call recording. It asks for microphone and notification access.
BCR plays no announcement or beep: the other party is not told that the call is being recorded.
Many places require every party's consent to record a call. You are responsible for following the law where you and the other party are.
While BCR records, don't use Google Phone's own Record button, and turn off features that listen to calls (Call Screen, Call Notes, Scam Detection, Voice Translate): two recorders on one call can fail.
Newer BCR releases from GitHub install over the built-in copy (same signature).

Known issues

Face unlock is DerpFest's camera-based face unlock, not the Pixel's secure face unlock, so it can't be used for payments or app sign-in. Use the fingerprint sensor for those.
Gemini Nano features that need Google's on-device models (Magic Cue and others) may not work: Google only serves those models to phones with a locked bootloader, on any custom ROM.
This is the first DerpFest build for husky. If something doesn't work, please post in this thread with a logcat (adb logcat -b all -d > log.txt) and your carrier.

Changelog

2026-10-21: First DerpFest v17 (Android 17) build for husky. LineageOS 24.0 device trees, October 2026 (CP3A.261005.005) firmware.

Requirements

Unlocked bootloader (unlocking wipes your phone)
Stock firmware CP3A.261005.005 (October 2026). The zip includes October 2026 firmware, but your phone should be on this release. If you're coming from an older release or beta, install CP3A.261005.005 with the Android Flash Tool first.
Latest platform-tools (adb/fastboot)
Coming from any other ROM: a clean install is required. Updates from other ROMs (and theirs from this one) won't install: this build is signed with its own keys.

Installation (clean flash)
Download the ROM zip and check its SHA-256. Download boot-20261021.img and vendor_boot-20261021.img from the same SourceForge folder, then:

	
	



	
		Code:
	
	
		adb reboot bootloader
fastboot flash boot boot-20261021.img
fastboot flash vendor_boot vendor_boot-20261021.img
fastboot reboot recovery
	
In the recovery:

Select Factory reset > Format data/factory reset > Format data (wipes all your data).
Return to the main menu and select Apply update > Apply from ADB.
From your computer, sideload the ROM:

	
	



	
		Code:
	
	
		adb sideload DerpFest-v17-20261021-husky-Unofficial-Stable.zip
	
After the sideload finishes (it stops around 47% with Total xfer: 1.00x), select Reboot system now. The first boot takes a few minutes.

Updating from an earlier build of this ROM keeps your data: use Settings > System > Updater, or reboot to recovery and sideload the new zip the same way.

Downloads

Pixel 8 Pro (husky): SourceForge: derpfest/husky
File: DerpFest-v17-20261021-husky-Unofficial-Stable.zip (2.87 GB)
SHA-256: 7ab1b0c5e04fb9c3279df8d319e4cad8442244f526fad8062425c3bbd674b94b
Recovery images: boot-20261021.img, vendor_boot-20261021.img (checksums in recovery-20261021.sha256)

Source code

ROM: DerpFest-AOSP/android_manifest (17)
Device trees: LineageOS/android_device_google_shusky and LineageOS/android_device_google_zuma (lineage-24.0), with five small DerpFest patches
Kernel: LineageOS/android_kernel_google_gs-6.1_manifest (lineage-24.0), GKI android14-6.1-2025-12_r30
Vendor blobs: TheMuppets/proprietary_vendor_google_husky

The LineageOS team (Michael Bestas and the Pixel maintainers) for the husky trees
